name: warrior-of-the-fae-realm-banished-sword-activatable-same-turn
notes: Warrior of the Fae Realm (eRcqucBKhX): "you may activate the banished card on a later turn." ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): the ActionMap "myBanish" branch (Custom/GameLogic.php) only requires the _warriorFaeRealm tag and the Warrior on the field -- it never checks that the card was banished on an EARLIER turn -- so the Striking Tides banished by this very On Enter can be activated right away in the same turn. The REGRESSION GUARD assertions pin the buggy outcome: the activation proceeds (3 further reserve payments), hits player 2's champion for 4 and the card ends in the graveyard. (Player 1 plays this on turn 3 because the first player cannot attack on turn 1.)

rulesClauses: you may activate the banished card on a LATER turn (not the same turn).

engineBug.summary: The Sword attack banished by the Warrior's own On Enter can be activated immediately in the SAME turn although the text only grants activation 'on a later turn'. The ActionMap 'myBanish' branch (Custom/GameLogic.php) only requires the _warriorFaeRealm turn-effect tag plus a Warrior on the field and never checks that the card was banished on an earlier turn. Confirmed live by the replay: the activation is accepted on the turn of the banish.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php ActionMap() case 'myBanish', the '_warriorFaeRealm' branch (tag + Warrior on field only)
engineBug.verification: Root cause confirmed live with a temporary file trace (restored afterwards): the myBanish click on the SAME turn as the banish logged tags=["_warriorFaeRealm"] turn=<same> warriorOnField=Y and proceeded. Break/restore: a per-turn marker (set with the tag, retained at end of turn, and refused on the turn it was set) flipped this guard red (no same-turn damage) and the later-turn guard red too; restored, shasums verified.
